· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $57.47): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 22.36% indicating continued volatility.

· Swing Support ($57.54): Support zone based on 5-day low($55.37) and Pivot S1($53.55).
· Swing Resistance ($60.24): Located just above current price, potential for increased short-term rebound momentum if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Attempting Higher Low formation): Price rising from 5-day low($55.37) to current($60.18), suggesting potential for recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.67x): Lower than 5-day average volume, reducing confidence in the price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Attempting accumulation phase): Oversold exit attempt and Higher Low formation attempt, with uncertainty due to low volume. Short-term rebound considered for entry.
